coordinate_contract.root: single root at world origin; scale 1.0; no inherited non-uniform scale
coordinate_contract.pelvis: direct child of root; anatomical hip pivot

classes.DEFORM: May influence skin and is exported.
classes.TWIST: Deform bone distributing axial rotation; exported.
classes.HELPER: Non-skin helper; excluded unless explicitly required by runtime.
classes.ATTACHMENT: Gameplay attachment marker/socket target; no skin influence.
